sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Talkative. Constant desire to do something

252


great, to undertake vast feats of strength. Cerebral
activity. Frightful persecutory hallucinations; sees and
feels hugs and worms. Moral sense blunted. Personal
appearance neglected. Thinks he hears unpleasant re-
marks about himself. Hallucinations of hearing.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Throbbing and bursting sensation. Pupils
dilated. Hearing greatly increased. Roaring and noises
in head.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Glaucoma, increased tension, decreased cor-
neal sensibility. Eyes staring, expressionless.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Dry, burning, tickling, constricted, paraly-
sis of muscles of deglutition. Speech difficult.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Loss of appetite for solid food. Likes
sweets. Hemorrhages from bowels, stomach.

Nervous System. — Ch()rea; paralysis agitans; alco-
holic tremors and senile trembling. Local sensory pa-
ralysis. Formication and numbness in hands and fore-
arms.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Restless, cannot sleep for hours after retir-
ing.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Stovain (an analgesic, a
vaso-motor dilator).
